svg.title: Circuit breaker over 901 outage lengths: timed-out calls, rejections after recovery, time to close
svg.desc: One request every 10 ms, outage from 1000 ms to 2000..11000 ms, timeout 1000 ms. Low medians of 901 runs. Deterministic simulation counts, not measured latency.

g.text: Circuit breaker during an outage / 100 req/s
Bar: calls that hung until the 1000 ms timeout. Right: rejected after recovery, time until CLOSED (low median of 901 outage lengths)
Breaker: last 20 calls, open at 50% failures (min 10), 3 trial calls in HALF_OPEN. Healthy calls take 20 ms.
Peak calls in flight was 100 in every run: the first failures are only known after the timeout.
